mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors prepare for potential slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 5.0% (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) indicates persistent price pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1 > 20000 billion) reflects robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 20000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs positive return baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightening regimes, strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150000) signals sustained economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate continued corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of labor market tightening periods when PAYEMS > 150000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs positive return baseline).
